Using theological description and analytical investigation, and with the doctrine of the Trinity as a framework, it examines the concept of mathētēs and the ontological identity of the Trinity as set forth in the Great Commission in Matthew 28:19-20, then analyzes key elements found in Jesus’ teachings on discipleship. It highlights the Holy Spirit’s role in maintaining humanity’s connection with the triune God, which results in four essential aspects for the follower of Jesus: justification, sanctification, the endowment of charismatic mission
